title: 1 C.N.C. § 1-101.5 — Territorial Applicability
text:
TERRITORIAL APPLICABILITY.
Except as provided otherwise, this Code refers only to the commission or omission of
acts within the territorial limits of the Nation and territories over which the Nation has the power
to govern in accordance with federal law and the Constitution. This Code also applies to that
territory outside the boundaries of this Nation over which the Nation has jurisdiction, ownership
or control by virtue of any constitutional or legal provision, or any law.
